# Plateer AI Labs

> Plateer AI Labs is an AI research lab building trustworthy Enterprise AI. It
> researches the technology behind autonomous agents, proves it through
> open-source Python libraries, and delivers it as products: XGEN (an on-premise
> Agentic AI Platform), Polar (a commerce-specialized private sLLM), and AI Code
> Assistant. Every open-source tool is free, MIT-licensed, installable with pip,
> and runnable directly in the browser gallery.

Site: https://labs.plateer.com
GitHub: https://github.com/PlateerLab

## Products

- [XGEN — Enterprise Agentic AI Platform](https://labs.plateer.com/product): On-premise platform to learn, build, deploy, and monitor Agentic AI services on the LLM and infrastructure of your choice. Agent Builder (visual workflow canvas), ModelOps, and a unified management center with RBAC/ABAC governance. GS certification grade 1; AI reliability certification (AI-MASTER) in progress.
- [Polar — Commerce sLLM](https://labs.plateer.com/polar): A commerce-specialized private small language model for search, customer service, and shopping experiences.
- [AI Code Assistant](https://labs.plateer.com/code-assistant): A coding assistant that learns an organization's own codebase, APIs, and schemas.
- [XGEN free trial](https://labs.plateer.com/xgen-trial): Build your own AI agent in a hosted demo environment before adopting XGEN.

## Open-source libraries

- [Contextifier](https://labs.plateer.com/tool/contextifier): Turn any document into AI-ready text across 80+ formats, preserving tables, code blocks, and structure for retrieval. `pip install contextifier` (Python, ingestion).
- [Doc2Chunk](https://labs.plateer.com/tool/doc2chunk): Context-aware chunking for RAG pipelines with configurable size and overlap. `pip install xgen-doc2chunk` (Python, ingestion).
- [f2a](https://labs.plateer.com/tool/f2a): Point at any file and get full statistics plus an interactive HTML report. 24+ formats. `pip install f2a` (Python, ingestion).
- [Document Adapter](https://labs.plateer.com/tool/document-adapter): Let LLMs edit DOCX, PPTX, and HWPX documents directly. `pip install document-adapter` (Python, ingestion).
- [Synaptic Memory](https://labs.plateer.com/tool/synaptic-memory): Brain-inspired knowledge graph with auto-ontology, Hebbian learning, and four-stage memory consolidation for long-running agents. `pip install synaptic-memory` (Python, knowledge).
- [Knowtology](https://labs.plateer.com/tool/knowtology): Tree-structured knowledge maps for agents. `pip install knowtology` (Python, knowledge).
- [OmniFuse](https://labs.plateer.com/tool/omnifuse): One-shot GraphRAG that fuses vector and graph retrieval. `pip install xgen-omnifuse` (Python, knowledge).
- [Googer](https://labs.plateer.com/tool/googer): Type-safe Google search for agents — web, images, news, and videos with typed responses. `pip install googer` (Python, agent).
- [Toolint](https://labs.plateer.com/tool/toolint): Structural linter for MCP agent tools. `pip install toolint` (Python, agent).
- [XGEN Harness](https://labs.plateer.com/tool/xgen-harness): A 10-stage execution harness that owns validation, retries, and termination for agents. `pip install xgen-harness` (Python, agent).
- [playwLeft](https://labs.plateer.com/tool/playleft): High-performance browser automation for agents. `pip install playleft` (Python, agent).

## Pages

- [Home](https://labs.plateer.com/): Research lab overview and the "research → open source → product → proof" narrative.
- [Research](https://labs.plateer.com/research): Research areas, methodology, applied research, and publications.
- [Research & Technology](https://labs.plateer.com/technology): Engines, frameworks (AgenticOps, GraphRAG, Hybrid RAG, Context Engineering), runtime, and reference architecture.
- [Open Source Gallery](https://labs.plateer.com/library-gallery): The open-source library gallery, recipes, and runtime — run each tool directly in the browser.
- [Applied AI](https://labs.plateer.com/solutions): Industry applications (commerce, finance, public sector, IT), PoC projects, proof-in-action demos, and enablement.
- [Customer Cases](https://labs.plateer.com/customers): How XGEN and AI Code Assistant are built and operated in real customer environments.
- [Insight (Blog)](https://labs.plateer.com/blog): Case studies, tech notes, and product news on Enterprise AI, Agentic AI, and GEO/SEO.
- [Members](https://labs.plateer.com/members): The researchers and open-source contributors building XGEN.
- [Releases](https://labs.plateer.com/releases): XGEN platform release notes and changelog.
- [About](https://labs.plateer.com/about): Mission, the research-to-product pipeline, certifications, and history.

## Languages

The site is served in Korean at the root and in English under `/en`. Every page
below has an English counterpart at the same path with an `/en` prefix, declared
with hreflang (`ko`, `en`, `x-default`). Korean is the default.

- [English home](https://labs.plateer.com/en) — the English entry point
- [English blog](https://labs.plateer.com/en/blog) — all 38 posts are translated; `/blog/<slug>` maps 1:1 to `/en/blog/<slug>`
- Example: `https://labs.plateer.com/product` ⇄ `https://labs.plateer.com/en/product`
- Publications on `/research` keep their original Korean bibliographic records (title, authors, venue) in both languages, as citations.

## About

- Identity: an AI research lab that proves its research through open-source and products.
- Products: XGEN (Agentic AI Platform), Polar (commerce sLLM), AI Code Assistant.
- Open-source category coverage: ingestion (Contextifier, Doc2Chunk, f2a, Document Adapter), knowledge (Synaptic Memory, Knowtology, OmniFuse), agent (Googer, Toolint, XGEN Harness, playwLeft).
- Common compositions: RAG pipeline (ingest → chunk → embed → retrieve), agent runtime with an execution harness, long-term memory knowledge graph.
- License: MIT. Language: Python. Install: pip.
